item.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Three Billion Streak
item.description:
Bitcoin ETFs Snap Three Billion Streak

The bid broke on a Friday. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $201.9 million of net outflows, ending a nine-day buying run that had absorbed $3.04 billion—the strongest uninterrupted ETF bid of this bear market, per Ecoinometrics and Farside Investors. Bitcoin slipped about 3.2 percent to $77,696. The number that had given this slump a floor was the daily creation of ETF shares. For nine sessions, that floor held. Then it did not.
